info.name: TVLore API
info.description: Collection for the TVLore API. Switch environments to target local or Vercel. Supabase Auth requests help obtain and validate the access token used by protected TVLore routes.

item.name: Auth / Supabase
item.description: Google login is handled by Supabase Auth. Use the OAuth helper to open Google, then copy the access_token from the callback URL fragment into supabaseAccessToken. Add the Postman callback URL to Supabase Auth redirect URLs before using this helper.

request.description: Starts Supabase Google OAuth. If Postman follows the redirect, use the final callback URL fragment to copy access_token and refresh_token into the selected environment.
